norms.title: How NSFDC decides
norms.intro: Before releasing funds to a {{type}}, NSFDC checks these conditions.
norms.missingTitle: Why we cannot tell you if this partner is lending
norms.missingBody: NSFDC publishes these rules but not the figures behind them. To answer, we would need: {{fields}}.
norms.sourceSnapshot: Source: {{title}} — read from the {{date}} archived copy; NSFDC's live page is gone.

rule.overdues: Nothing has been owed to NSFDC for more than a year.
rule.utilisation: At least {{pct}}% of funds already received have been lent out.
rule.guarantee: A state government or bank guarantee is in place.
rule.rrbNpa: Net NPA below {{pct}}% in at least {{years}} of the last {{of}} years.
rule.rrbProfit: Net profit in at least {{years}} of the last {{of}} financial years.
rule.rrbStandUp: Under Stand-up India a tighter test applies — net NPA below {{pct}}%.
rule.psbMoa: A memorandum of agreement with NSFDC is in force.
rule.psbUtilisationCertificate: A utilisation certificate has been filed for earlier NSFDC refinance.
rule.psbNoOverdue: Nothing is owed to NSFDC on the day funds are released.
rule.mfiRegistration: Registered with the RBI as an NBFC-MFI and following its micro-finance norms.
rule.mfiNpa: Gross NPA below {{gross}}% and net NPA below {{net}}% last financial year.
rule.mfiRating: A capacity assessment rating of at least {{rating}}.
rule.mfiBureau: A member of a credit bureau.
rule.mfiNoDefault: No default on other borrowings in {{years}} years, and no debt restructuring.

input.netNpaHistory: net NPA for each of the last six years
input.netProfitHistory: profit or loss for each of the last six years
input.unutilisedLimit: funds received but not yet lent out
input.guaranteeInPlace: whether a government guarantee is in place
input.moaInForce: whether the agreement with NSFDC is current
input.utilisationCertificateFiled: whether the utilisation certificate was filed
